# Create {.phase-create}

```{=html}
<div class="phase-rule phase-create"></div>
```

Create is the first block of the PFTC toolbox.
It has three steps.

- **Plan.** Set the course and the field plan.
- **Design.** Decide what to measure, and how plots and leaves are chosen.
- **Collect.** Take the leaves and record the traits in the field.

Design and collection are written up as [the trait wheel](5_trait_collection.qmd).
